extracted.intended_audience: organizations and practitioners that produce fact-checks (newsrooms, independent fact-checking groups)
extracted.subtask_short: IFCN Code of Principles signatory criteria
extracted.subtask_description: Guiding principles and eligibility orientation for organizations seeking to be signatories to the International Fact-Checking Network Code of Principles — focused on nonpartisan, accuracy-focused reporting on public claims. Useful for fact-checking organizations preparing an application or aligning editorial practices to IFCN expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: organizations that regularly publish nonpartisan reports on the accuracy of statements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Code of Principles is for organizations that regularly publish nonpartisan reports on the accuracy of statements by public figures, major institutions, and other widely circulated claims of interest to society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Code results from consultations among fact-checkers worldwide and offers conscientious practitioners principles to aspire to in their everyday work. (Page also references related sections such as 'The commitments', 'Advisory board', 'Our assessors', 'Complaints', and application guidance, implying procedural and transparency elements tied to signatory status.)
